crn_design_and_control.query: TITLE_ABS:("chemical reaction network" OR "biochemical reaction network" OR "biomolecular network") AND TITLE_ABS:(design OR synthesis OR engineering OR control)

logic_circuits.query: TITLE_ABS:("synthetic biology" OR "synthetic gene circuit" OR "biomolecular circuit") AND TITLE_ABS:("logic gate" OR "Boolean logic" OR "genetic logic")

oscillators.query: TITLE_ABS:(synthetic OR engineered OR biomolecular) AND TITLE_ABS:("genetic oscillator" OR "biological oscillator" OR "synthetic oscillator" OR "oscillatory circuit")

robust_perfect_adaptation.query: TITLE_ABS:("robust perfect adaptation" OR "integral feedback" OR "antithetic integral" OR "integral control") AND TITLE_ABS:(biomolecular OR biochemical OR biological OR synthetic)

stochastic_rpa_noise_control.query: TITLE_ABS:("synthetic gene circuit" OR "genetic circuit" OR "biomolecular control" OR "biochemical reaction network") AND TITLE_ABS:(stochastic OR noise OR variance)

dose_response.query: TITLE_ABS:("synthetic biology" OR "gene circuit" OR "genetic circuit" OR "biochemical network" OR "signaling network") AND TITLE_ABS:("dose response" OR ultrasensitivity OR bistability)

classification.query: TITLE_ABS:("synthetic biology" OR "gene circuit" OR "genetic circuit" OR "biomolecular circuit" OR "molecular circuit") AND TITLE_ABS:(classifier OR classification OR "pattern recognition" OR "cellular decision")

tracking.query: TITLE_ABS:("biomolecular circuit" OR "biochemical network" OR "synthetic biology" OR "gene circuit" OR "gene regulatory network") AND TITLE_ABS:("signal tracking" OR "reference tracking" OR "feedback control" OR "dynamic control")

habituation.query: TITLE_ABS:("cellular habituation" OR "non-neuronal habituation" OR "biochemical habituation" OR "molecular habituation")
